about_short_description.short_description: Bidaya is a provider of home financing services.

product.name: Residential Land Financing
product.description: Provides financing for purchasing residential land with flexible repayment plans and coverage up to 85% of land value or 25 million SAR.

product.name: Ready Residential Unit Financing
product.description: Finances the purchase of ready residential units with flexible repayment terms and coverage up to 25 million SAR.

product.name: Expatriate Home Financing
product.description: Offers home financing solutions for expatriates residing in Saudi Arabia with financing up to 3 million SAR.

product.name: Land Financing
product.description: Financing product for purchasing land, offering up to 85% financing of land value or 25 million SAR with flexible repayment options.

product.name: Buy & Lease Back Financing
product.description: A financing service that enables customers to sell their property and lease it back, providing liquidity while retaining use of the property.

product.name: Commercial Financing
product.description: Provides financing solutions for commercial real estate and business purposes within Saudi Arabia.
